title: Smt. Krishna Devi Mishra v. State of U.P. & Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan and Virendra Singh, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; remaining bill grievance relegated to Supply Code forum.
headnote: Where a consumer's representation against an electricity bill has already been considered and an amended bill issued, a mandamus to decide that representation does not survive. Any remaining grievance against the amended bill must be taken to the forum under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Smt. Krishna Devi Mishra sought a mandamus that the respondents decide her representation dated 20 August 2009 on a disputed electricity bill. During listing the licensee produced a temporary disconnection slip dated 17 March 2008 recording meter reading 40709 and arrears of Rs.55,261. Counter, supplementary counter and rejoinder affidavits were then filed. The supplementary counter placed an amended bill dated 31 January 2010 for Rs.93,974, after Rs.12,000 had been accounted for on the representation.

holding_units.holding: Once the representation on a bill dispute has been considered and an amended bill issued, a consumer still aggrieved of that bill must take the forum provided under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; a writ of mandamus to decide the representation does not survive.
holding_units.flag: court did not identify 6.5 or 6.8; referred only to the forum under the Supply Code, 2005

not_decided.point: correctness of the amended electricity bill dated 31 January 2010 for Rs.93,974
not_decided.note: left to the forum under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
